resources.string: Shows the latest Bitcoin price from cheeserobot.org
Pick how you want the BTC price displayed
Live BTC price on your home screen

1. Long-press an empty spot on your home screen.
2. Tap "Widgets".
3. Find "Cheese BTC Widget" in the list.
4. Drag "BTC Price" onto the home screen.
5. Choose USD or EUR.
Take me to the home screen
Tap any widget to refresh it. The widget also updates itself about every 30 minutes.
No widgets placed yet — add one from the home screen.
